liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Neil Cassidy Raps** (1 review): Listener suggests a brief Lovelight moment occurs around the one-fifty mark [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1965-11-01.sbd.bershaw.5417.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 2 songs; 12 min; rated 3.32/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds like it was captured through a fly's ear, with sluggish guitar riffs; Listener speculates the recording used open microphones scattered around an acid test [3][9]

## Around the show

- Listener asks Neal to hum bars of an unknown song during the rap [2]
- Reviewer notes this was their first archive listen a year prior to 2011 [6]
- A trumpet is heard played around the four-minute mark of the recording [9]
- Reviewer finds hearing Cassady interesting but wishes the recording contained more than snippets [10]
- Reviewer declares this recording the start of their personal Grateful Dead year [13]
- Recording released as a flexi-disc in the first printing of The Dead Book [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1965-11-01.sbd.bershaw.5417.sbeok.shnf**: Reviewer asks if another fuller version of this recording is currently circulating; Extended version of Cassady and the Dead exists from the Straight Theater opening; Lawrence Schiller confirms the tape originated from a studio session by Fire and Ice [1][5][7][8]
